title: Customers receiving incorrect items in their orders
situation: Multiple customers are reporting receiving items that do not match their original purchase, requiring immediate logistics investigation.
hypothesis: Warehouse fulfillment error shipping incorrect items

params.note: Multiple reports of incorrect items being delivered. Please investigate recent packing accuracy.

actions.why: Requires warehouse investigation to identify the root cause of the fulfillment error.

params.reply_en: I am sorry you received the wrong item. I have escalated this to our logistics team to investigate and will follow up with you shortly on the next steps for your exchange.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن استلامك منتجاً غير الذي طلبته. قمت برفع المشكلة لفريق الخدمات اللوجستية للتحقق، وسأتواصل معك قريباً لتنسيق عملية الاستبدال.

actions.why: Acknowledges the error and sets expectations while the team investigates.

actions.title: Received wrong item
actions.answer_en: If you received the wrong item, please contact our support team with your order number and a photo of the item received so we can arrange a replacement.
actions.answer_ar: إذا استلمت منتجاً غير الذي طلبته، يرجى التواصل مع فريق الدعم مع تزويدنا برقم الطلب وصورة للمنتج المستلم لنتمكن من ترتيب عملية الاستبدال.
